errors.evidence: Description states the dark blue line (Squared-Exponential) ends at approximately 53, but the figure shows it maintains an accuracy above 55.
Describes the TanH model starting at approximately 46, when it actually starts at about 48.
States that the ELU model begins at approximately 42, while it actually starts at about 46.
The description does not mention that no lines intersect each other, an important feature of the plot.
Fails to mention the y-axis range is from 45 to 55, as indicated in the image.
Confusing phrasing; the dark blue line represents the Squared Exponential model, not a combination of Squared-Exponential TanH.
Describes the pink dashed line as 'L.L.aMA-2-chat-7B', but the correct notation is 'LLAMA-2-chat-7B' as per the figure.
